_about: FCI country (or Wikidata P495 value) -> place on the map: kind, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, Wikidata item whose P625 gives the point and P30 the continent. Drafted with Claude Code on 2026-11-04; reviewed=false until Paul checks it.

entries.label: Japan
entries.basis: FCI country name; Wikidata item found by label, P625 gives the point.

entries.label: China
entries.basis: FCI country name; Wikidata item found by label, P625 gives the point.
doubts: Wikidata P495 of the Pug points to a "China" item without ISO code (historical China), not to Q148.

entries.label: Tibet (China)
entries.basis: FCI writes "Tibet (China)": ISO code of China (CN), point from Q17269 Tibet Autonomous Region (P625).
doubts: Country CN but point in Tibet: the label keeps the FCI wording. Tibet as a region (no ISO) would be the alternative.
